# Ancient Rome Live

> > Ancient Rome Live is an educational platform by the American Institute for Roman Culture providing comprehensive resources on Roman history, archaeology, architecture, and cultural heritage.

The site features detailed guides to Roman monuments, archaeological sites, and historical periods, alongside free seminars and lectures by experts like Darius Arya. Content spans the Roman Empire from the Regal Period through late antiquity, with coverage extending to related civilizations like Petra and medieval topics including the Fourth Crusade.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Rome
- Roman Empire
- Roman architecture
- Roman archaeology
- Pompeii
- Palatine Hill
- Via Appia
- Forum of Trajan
- Ara Pacis
- Septimius Severus
- Cultural heritage preservation
- Imperial cult and deification
- Roman tombs and funerary monuments
- Amphitheaters
- Cities of Empire

## Monuments and Architecture of Rome

- [Ara Pacis Augustae](https://ancientromelive.org/ara-pacis-augustae): Guide to Augustus' Ara Pacis sculptural altar monument in Rome
- [Rome's 7 Hills; the Palatine Hill and Surrounding Area](https://ancientromelive.org/palatinus-mons-palatine-hill): Guide to Palatine Hill, residence of Rome's elite and emperors
- [Forum Traiani (Forum of Trajan)](https://ancientromelive.org/forum-traiani-forum-of-trajan): Reference page on Trajan's Forum in Rome's imperial forums complex
- [Amphitheaters (Amphitheatrum)](https://ancientromelive.org/amphitheatrum-amphitheaters-general): Overview of Roman amphitheater architecture and building types
- [Ancient Roman Tombs](https://ancientromelive.org/tombs-general): Overview of ancient Roman burial monuments and funerary architecture
- [Regia](https://ancientromelive.org/regia): Reference page on the Regia building in the Roman Forum
- [Capitoline Trophies (Tropaea Marii)](https://ancientromelive.org/capitoline-trophies-tropaea-marii): Reference page on Capitoline Trophies Roman sculpture monuments

## Cities and Archaeological Sites

- [Pompeii from Above](https://ancientromelive.org/pompeii-from-above): Aerial drone footage and summary of Pompeii archaeological site
- [Via Appia: Introduction, from Rome to Brindisi](https://ancientromelive.org/via-appia-introduction-from-rome-to-brindisi): Introduction to Via Appia ancient road from Rome to Brindisi
- [Decline and Rediscovery of Petra](https://ancientromelive.org/decline-and-rediscovery-of-petra): History of Petra's decline and archaeological rediscovery
- [Aquinum](https://ancientromelive.org/ecl/aquinum): Archaeological site guide to Aquinum with theater and engineering

## People and Historical Periods

- [Emperor Septimius Severus](https://ancientromelive.org/septimiusseverus): Profile of Emperor Septimius Severus (193-211 CE) and his legacy
- [Regal Period](https://ancientromelive.org/regal-period): Reference page on Rome's Regal Period and early monarchy

## Free Seminars and Lectures

- [Becoming a God; the Deification of the Roman Emperor Lecture](https://ancientromelive.org/becoming-a-god-the-deification-of-the-roman-emperor): Lecture on Roman emperor deification and imperial cult by Darius Arya
- [[FREE SEMINAR] An Overview of Regal Rome](https://ancientromelive.org/event/an-overview-of-regal-rome): Free seminar examining early Rome's archaeology and historical evidence
- [Seminar - The Myths of Ancient Rome](https://ancientromelive.org/seminar-the-myths-of-ancient-rome): Seminar exploring ancient Roman myths and their real-world locations
- [[FREE SEMINAR] Spoils of War: the Fourth Crusade and Venice](https://ancientromelive.org/event/free-seminar-spoils-of-war-the-fourth-crusade-and-venice): Free seminar on 1204 Sack of Constantinople artifacts in Venice
- [[FREE SEMINAR] Who were the Normans?](https://ancientromelive.org/event/free-seminar-who-were-the-normans): Free seminar on Norman Sicily and Palermo's Cappella Palatina

- [The American Institute for Roman Culture](https://ancientromelive.org/museum-week-2020-collaboration-may-11-17): About AIRC organization and Ancient Rome Live educational platform
